title: Website
brandInGymDetails: Change your brand color in Gym details
help: Your public website shows your schedule, programs, memberships and public coach profiles from the rest of the app. Add your logo, photos and a few words about the gym here. The brand color is set in Gym details.
error: The website settings could not be loaded or saved. Try again.
conflict: These settings changed elsewhere. They have been reloaded; check them and save again.
invalid: Check the fields and try again.
uploadsOff: This install doesn’t accept uploads, so the logo and photos can’t be changed here.
noLogo: No logo yet. The website and public pages show the gym's name.
uploadLogo: Upload a logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP)
replaceLogo: Replace the logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP)
imageInvalid: That image can't be used. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
taglineHelp: One short line under the gym's name on the home page; search engines also show it.
aboutHelp: Shown on the home page. Line breaks are kept.
photosHelp: Up to {max} photos. The first one is the large photo on the home page; the others form a gallery.
altFirst: Description of photo {number} (the home page photo)
removedHelp: Removed photos are deleted when you save.
addPhoto: Add a photo (PNG, JPEG or WebP)
addPhotoHelp: Large photos are resized before upload.
photosFull: Remove a photo and save before adding another.
photoAdded: Photo added. Describe it for people using screen readers, then save.
